name: Apocalypse Rising 2
desc:
Test your skills as you brave the unfolding zombie apocalypse! Survive alone or with friends in this open-world tactical shooter!

📢 The classic "Reimagined" map from the original Apocalypse Rising has been added to AR2 with Mobile support!

🔫 Find over 100 different guns and melee weapons to fend off the Infected and hostile players!
🌎 Explore the towns and countryside of a diverse archipelago on foot, or find and repair a variety of cars and boats to drive!
🎒 Gather equipment and supplies, including food, ammo, utilities, weapon attachments, and vehicles parts!
🎩 Unlock over 1,000 cosmetics by exploring the archipelago, discovering secret locations, hidden rooms, and random events like helicopter crash sites!
🧟‍♂️ Hunt down unique Infected to unlock Rare cosmetics, and use melee weapons to quietly stealth-attack them for increased loot chances!
📰 Join our community chat server for news and more.
